summary.text:
Make Autorail Great Again Act
This bill prohibits the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) from receiving any federal funding until the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority Compact is amended to rename (1) WMATA as the Washington Metropolitan Authority for Greater Access or the WMAGA, and (2) the Metrorail as the Trump Train.
